text:
arjun: Quick sync — can we finalize a recommended packaging + naming + compatibility rubric for quant bundles that Redwood Optimize will consume? Need something we can ship to eng-runtime and docs this week.

elena: +1. Main asks: clear manifest fields, compatibility tags (runtime, model arch), and a migration story for old qpacks.
maria: High level: keep it minimal. Consumers need: quant_backend, qfmt_version, model_id, base_model_hash, eval_delta, representative_inputs, and optional hw_tune hints.
noah: Suggest a single `manifest.yaml` inside the bundle: human readable for audits, machine-validated by the qpkg tool. Example fields I want to see:
```
format: quant-bundle
format_version: "2"
model: "llama-3-32k"
base_model_sha: "c0ffee..."
quant_method: "gptq"
quant_backend: "awq"
quant_bits: "8"
calib_dataset: "redwood/repcal-v1"
eval: {task_set: "redwood-q-a", metric: "acc@5", delta: "-0.8%"}
compat: ["runtime>=1.4.0", "kernels:fp8:v2"]
notes: "float fallback available"
```
sam: love the `compat` list. Also add a `compat_matrix` entry for the bundle builder where we enumerate tested hw targets and perf deltas e.g. `a100: +0.2ms, gpusw: -1.5%` so ops can choose route policies.
optimize-bot: reminder: bundles without `format_version` will be rejected by qpkg-validator after 2027-01-01. :rotating_light:
elena: Naming convention proposal: `<model>-<quantmethod>-<backend>-v<fmt>-<semver>.qpkg` e.g. `llama3-32k-gptq-awq-v2-0.1.0.qpkg`. Keeps everything discoverable and sortable.
arjun: Regarding semver: we should distinguish `format` vs `bundle` versions. `fmt` changes when manifest schema changes; semver when content (e.g., re-calibration) changes. Agree?
maria: yep. `fmt` bump = breaking manifest change. `bundle` patch bump = non-functional metadata tweak. Minor bump = recalibration or different calibration dataset. Major = different quant algorithm.
noah: Important: add `compatibility_tags` separate from `compat`. Tags are short tokens runtime can use for routing: e.g. `awq_v1_compat`, `fp8_pack_v2`, `int8_sym`. That helps match without parsing ranges.
elena: Also we need `fallback_policy` in manifest: `fallback_to: ["fp16-host", "int8-safe"]`, with recommended order. If a bundle fails runtime checks, runtime falls back to next.
sam: For Redwood Optimize recommenders, we should surface per-bundle expected quality delta vs hosted baseline, and a suggested `deployment_profile` like `latency_opt`, `cost_opt`, `balanced`. This drives default routing rules.
arjun: Ops question — how do we encode AB-test metadata? e.g., which bundles were part of a canary and their observed metrics.
maria: add `eval_history` array with tuples: `[{ts: 1898760000, saw: {latency: 12.3, acc_delta: -0.9}}, ...]`. Keep max N entries to avoid bloat.
noah: Security: manifest must include `signing_key` or `publisher` and a `sig` file in the qpkg root. qpkg-validator should verify signatures against allowlist.
optimize-bot: action: create qpkg-validator PR to enforce `manifest.format_version` and required fields (model, base_model_sha, quant_method, quant_backend, eval.delta, compat).
elena: Migration: write a small converter `qpkg migrate` that adds `format_version: "2"` and attempts best-effort mapping for `compat` and `compatibility_tags`. Mark migrated bundles with `migrated_from: <old_format>` in metadata.
sam: UX note: show a single line summary in Optimize UI: `llama3-32k | gptq-awq | acc -0.8% | latency +0.2ms | nxt: fp16` and a link to full manifest.
arjun: Testing policy: every PR that adds a new bundle must include a `redwood-eval` run against the official evaluation suite and the `representative_inputs` sample. Without passing thresholds, Optimize should mark the bundle `quarantine`.
maria: threshold defaults: abs(delta <= 1.0% for cost_opt; <=0.5% for balanced; <=0.2% for latency_opt). Teams can override per-model.
elena: One more: put `serialization_hint` for memory layout e.g. `packed: true` or `kv_cache_layout: "interleaved"` to help runtime choose kernel path.
noah: Implementation timeline: I can draft manifest schema and qpkg-validator changes in 2 days. arjun + elena will review, then we can cut docs + migrate script.
arjun: Perfect. Can someone file a GH issue with the manifest example and the `compatibility_tags` taxonomy? I'll assign.
maria: I filed GH #3227 with manifest YAML and sample qpkg. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/qpkg/issues/3227
arjun: Thanks. Let's land validator PR before end of week. :thumbsup:
